name: Extra Mote of Movement
body:
Prerequisite(s): Rogue 2, Jaunter’s Hop,

Benefit(s): Your pool of moments of movement increases by 2.

Special: You can gain this rogue talent multiple times. Its effects stack, granting you an increase to your pool of motes of movement each time you take this rogue talent.
